record.paper_title: Selection Principles and Special Sets of Reals
record.original_question: If a set of reals X satisfies S1(BΩ, BΩ) or Sfin(BΩ, BΩ), must every finite power X^k satisfy the same property?

evidence.quote: Are any of the classes S1(BΩ, BΩ) or Sfin(BΩ, BΩ) preserved by finite powers?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a set of real numbers (equivalently, a separable metrizable zero-dimensional space). A countable family $\mathcal{U}$ of Borel subsets of $X$ is called a Borel $\omega$-cover of $X$ if $X \notin \mathcal{U}$ and for every finite set $F \subseteq X$ there exists $U \in \mathcal{U}$ with $F \subseteq U$. Let $\mathcal{B}_\Omega$ denote the collection of all countable Borel $\omega$-covers of $X$.

For collections $\mathcal{A}$ and $\mathcal{B}$ of families of subsets of $X$:
- $X$ satisfies $S_1(\mathcal{A}, \mathcal{B})$ if, for every sequence $(\mathcal{U}_n)_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$ with each $\mathcal{U}_n \in \mathcal{A}$, there exist $U_n \in \mathcal{U}_n$ such that $\{U_n : n \in \mathbb{N}\} \in \mathcal{B}$.
- $X$ satisfies $S_{\mathrm{fin}}(\mathcal{A}, \mathcal{B})$ if, for every sequence $(\mathcal{U}_n)_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$ with each $\mathcal{U}_n \in \mathcal{A}$, there exist finite sets $\mathcal{F}_n \subseteq \mathcal{U}_n$ such that $\bigcup_{n\in\mathbb{N}} \mathcal{F}_n \in \mathcal{B}$.

Question: If a set of reals $X$ satisfies $S_1(\mathcal{B}_\Omega, \mathcal{B}_\Omega)$, must $X^k$ satisfy $S_1(\mathcal{B}_\Omega, \mathcal{B}_\Omega)$ for every positive integer $k$? Analogously, if $X$ satisfies $S_{\mathrm{fin}}(\mathcal{B}_\Omega, \mathcal{B}_\Omega)$, must every finite power $X^k$ satisfy $S_{\mathrm{fin}}(\mathcal{B}_\Omega, \mathcal{B}_\Omega)$?
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not produce a definitive resolution of whether the classes $S_1(\mathcal{B}_\Omega,\mathcal{B}_\Omega)$ and $S_{\mathrm{fin}}(\mathcal{B}_\Omega,\mathcal{B}_\Omega)$ are preserved by finite powers. Related work on Borel covers (Scheepers–Tsaban) and recent results on finite powers and products of Menger-type sets exists, but no clear statement settling this specific preservation question was located, so the status is reported as unknown.

status_evidence.title: The combinatorics of Borel covers (related literature)
status_evidence.snippet: Constructions of sets that are Menger in all finite powers with non-Menger products; related to questions about preservation of selection principles under powers/products.
status_evidence.claim: Finite-power and product behavior of selection principles is an active topic, but the Borel-omega versions are not explicitly resolved in the sources found.

status_evidence.title: Selection principles in topology: New directions (Scheepers)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of selection principles including Borel-cover variants and questions about their structural properties.
status_evidence.claim: No explicit resolution of the finite-power preservation question for $S_1(\mathcal{B}_\Omega,\mathcal{B}_\Omega)$ or $S_{\mathrm{fin}}(\mathcal{B}_\Omega,\mathcal{B}_\Omega)$ is given.
